name: Fesselbiss
description:
You latch onto a foe, never to let go. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

On a hit, you grapple the target. On your subsequent turns, while you are grappling a creature with this move, you can activate it again as a bonus action, with an automatic hit, dealing 2d6 {type} damage. This move can grapple targets up to two sizes larger than you.

updated.details: Subsequent activations are a bonus action that automatically hit for 2d6 damage.
